What gets installed

Five systems. One local installer.

Every job starts with the property in front of us — a brick two-family in Ridgewood, a storefront in Glendale, a home office that outgrew its router. Pick one system or combine them; the quote starts with a call.

Representative photo
01 — Watch

CCTV — Security Cameras

Cameras placed where they actually matter: the front door, the driveway, the side alley, the register. CCTV installation covers the cameras, the runs behind them, and a setup you can check when you're away from the property.

  • Exterior and interior camera placement
  • Homes, multi-family buildings, and businesses
  • Pairs naturally with a Ring doorbell at the entry
Add CCTV to my system →
Representative photo
02 — Alert

Burglar Alarms

An alarm is the difference between a break-in you hear about tomorrow and one that gets interrupted tonight. Burglar alarm installation covers the panel, the entry points, and arming the system the way your household or staff will actually use it.

  • Keypad at the door you use every day
  • Coverage for doors and ground-floor windows
  • For homes and businesses alike
Add a burglar alarm to my system →
Representative photo
03 — Connect

Data Networks

Cameras, registers, and workstations are only as reliable as the network underneath them. Data network installation means proper cabling and connections — the clean rack, not the tangle behind the desk.

  • Structured cabling for homes and businesses
  • The backbone your cameras and systems run on
  • Built to be serviced, not guessed at
Add a data network to my system →
Representative photo
04 — Answer

Ring

The front door is where deliveries, visitors, and problems all show up first. Ring installation puts a video doorbell at that door — mounted, powered, and connected — so you can see and answer it from wherever you are.

  • Video doorbell installation at your entry
  • See and speak to visitors from your phone
  • A simple first step into a fuller camera system
Add Ring to my system →
Representative photo
05 — Enjoy

Audio / Video Systems

Not every wire in the wall is about security. Audio/video installation covers the screens and speakers a home or business runs on — a family room that sounds right, or a space where presentations and music just work.

  • TV and speaker setups for living spaces
  • Audio/video for businesses and common areas
  • Runs alongside your network and camera wiring
Add audio/video to my system →
